title: Nvidia agrees to pay $290M to settle a 2018 class action lawsuit alleging it misled shareholders about how much crypto mining fueled its GPU sales (Mike Scarcella/Reuters)
summary: Mike Scarcella / Reuters: Nvidia agrees to pay $290M to settle a 2018 class action lawsuit alleging it misled shareholders about how much crypto mining fueled its GPU sales — Nvidia (NVDA.O) has agreed to pay $290 million to settle a long-running investor lawsuit alleging the chipmaker misled shareholders …
